Subject: CAIQ evidence request — production telemetry and key rotation artifacts

Hi Marcus / Marissa,

Thanks for the quick sync yesterday. GrowthBank's security team is completing the CSA CAIQ review and we have a few follow-up asks that came out of the technical deep dive. We're trying to keep the window tight for our audit — target turnaround is EOD next Thursday. Can you confirm owners and whether you can produce the items below?

Required artifacts
- A 48-hour sampled runtime telemetry export (anonymized) that shows request routing, model variant fallbacks, and per-route latency/queue metrics. We don't need raw PII; redacted examples are fine.
- A short narrative + excerpt demonstrating your KV cache eviction policy and a sample of cache-miss traces for a 30-minute spike.
- KMS rotation schedule and an ops snippet showing the last rotation event (timestamp + actor).
- DocuSign attestation that the CAIQ answers in the packet are final for the requested scope.

Attachments: GrowthBank_CAİQ_Walkthrough.pdf (our expected evidence template)

If it's easier, provide a staged handoff (index CSV + presigned Drive links) and we'll pick up from there. Also flag any controls you want to safelist from sampling — our auditors can accommodate a small set.

Appreciate it — Sara

Sara Jenkins
Senior Security PM, GrowthBank
sara.jenkins@growthbank.com

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>

Sara — thanks for the clear list. We can deliver a staged handoff and I will be the primary concierge for GrowthBank. High-level plan below; I added owners and estimated delivery windows.

Plan & owners
- Telemetry export (48-hr sample, redacted): Owner: Marissa Cole — delivery: 2026-11-24 16:00 PT. Format: gzipped JSONL, schema documented in index CSV.
- KV cache eviction narrative + spike traces: Owner: Marcus Lin (me) — delivery: 2026-11-24 12:00 PT. Will include short explanation of eviction timers, TTL heuristics, and a 30-min trace.
- KMS rotation snippet + schedule: Owner: Kimberly Park — delivery: 2026-11-23 18:00 PT. We'll provide the rotation log excerpt and the policy doc reference.
- DocuSign attestation: Kimberly to send signing envelope today; target signature by 2026-11-25.

I've attached an evidence index (mb-evidence-index.csv) that maps each CAIQ control id to the artifact file name / link and the internal owner. We'll use the "snapback" staging approach — we upload artifacts to a secured Drive folder, rotate access tokens, then rotate tokens again after your ingestion. It avoids large single-download windows.

A couple of clarifications:
1) For telemetry, is the auditor OK with synthetic user IDs redacted and request payload bodies omitted? We will keep trace ids and timing intact.
2) For KMS rotation, do you need HSM attestation or just the audit entry showing rotation events?

Attachments: mb-evidence-index.csv, kms-rotation-snippet.txt

I'll queue the uploads once Kimberly confirms the envelope.

— Marcus
Principal, Security Engineering
Redwood Inference

Thanks Marcus — I have one quick note on the telemetry sample. GrowthBank asked for routing + fallback traces; we'll include an example where a regional capacity fallback occurred (timestamped) but we'll strip host-level instance ids. Also planning to include a README.md in the drive folder that documents the sampling windows and the redaction rules.

Sara — is the auditor OK with the fallback example being synthetic-replayed (we replay the request headers and timings but tag it as "replay-sample")? We do this frequently to avoid exposing customer identifiers while preserving fidelity of latency and routing behavior. If yes, I'll mark those traces in the index as "replay-excerpt".

Marissa
